channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from SSbreakingHeadlines, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: National Guard member wounded in DC shooting, police say
item.description: Police said they were investigating a shooting near the 400 block of 8th Street SE.

item.title: Jeffries sees strong Democratic odds for House while campaigning in Ohio
item.description: House Democratic leader Hakeem Jeffries said the electoral environment remains favorable for Democrats as they seek to regain the House.

item.title: Lt. Gov. candidate Shawn Oliver arrested, suspends campaign
item.description: Shawn Oliver, a New Bedford city councilor and Republican candidate for lieutenant governor, suspended his campaign after being arrested early Sunday.

item.title: Boy among two killed when truck enters Wichita soccer field
item.description: A 6-year-old boy and a 35-year-old man were killed during a soccer game at Stryker Soccer Complex in Wichita, Kansas, police said.
